result.summary: Found 3 issues related to horizontal content overflow and inconsistent styling in a food delivery app interface.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel has cards cut off at the right edge. The third item 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word and its image is clipped, making the content appear broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer visual affordance for horizontal scrolling (e.g., partial card peek with consistent spacing) and ensure text truncation uses ellipsis cleanly without cutting the card container abruptly.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off at the right edge with an additional item partially hidden, without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Provide a visual cue such as a fade gradient or partially visible chip to indicate more categories are available by scrolling.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons are styled inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards. The top card uses an outlined heart on a white circle, while the bottom card uses a white outlined heart on a dark circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and styling across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
